info.name: Delivez - Confidential Delivery (Vault) - Production
info.description:
STANDALONE PRODUCTION POSTMAN COLLECTION for Delivez Confidential Delivery (Delivez Vault) strictly aligned with the Flutter/Dart specification.

Pre-configured for Production Server:
- Base URL: http://40.81.244.167:3012/api/v1 (or domain: https://api.delivez.com/api/v1)
- Pre-loaded Credentials: User mobile & admin email pre-configured for instant token handshakes
- Auto-Variables: Login and booking endpoints automatically save tokens and IDs to collection variables
- Includes 5 Folders:
  1. Authentication (User & Admin login, Profile check)
  2. Discovery & Pricing (Options, Quote calculation)
  3. Bookings (All 9 Flutter Service Types with exact conditional payloads: Secure, Direct, Precise, Hand Carry, Return, Exchange, Critical, MultiPoint + List, Details, Sandbox Payment, Cancel)
  4. Live Tracking & Milestones (4 Tabs: Timeline with 6 milestones, Details, Security, Documents, plus OTP Verification)
  5. Admin Operations (List all bookings, Update status with location & note)

You can import ONLY this file into Postman and execute requests immediately without needing an environment file.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Login requests to obtain customer and admin access tokens. Test scripts automatically store tokens to both collection and environment variables.

request.description: Authenticates customer user and automatically saves token into {{token}} and {{accessToken}} variables.
Authenticates administrator and automatically saves token into {{adminAccessToken}} and {{adminToken}}.
Verifies the active token and returns the current user profile.
Fetches all available service types, security levels, packaging options, item types, verification methods, handling options, and access requirements.
Calculates total pricing, base fare, security handling fee, add-on protections, and GST breakdown.
